releaseNotes:
v1.4.11 - Weel Jwok (Bible)

Added complete Bible in Dha Anywaa language (Weel Jwok):
- 66 books: 39 Old Testament + 27 New Testament
- Browse by OT/NT tabs, select book, select chapter
- Verse-by-verse reading with verse numbers and section headings
- Audio playback per chapter (streams from Firebase, requires internet)
- Continue reading banner remembers last position
- Previous/Next chapter navigation
- Added to sidebar drawer as 'Weel Jwok'
- Added as 4th home screen shortcut
- Firebase Analytics: bible_chapter_opened and bible_audio_played events

All content works offline (text). Audio requires internet connection.
